name: telemetry.dev Ingest API
description: OTLP/HTTP ingest for telemetry.dev, the observability platform for AI and LLM apps. Every model call, tool step, and retrieval arrives as OpenTelemetry spans with tokens, cost, latency, and errors attached. The API is versioned by URL path (/v1). Deprecation policy: breaking changes ship under a new /vN prefix, this document announces each deprecation, and a deprecated version answers with a Sunset header once its removal date is set. Authenticate with a project API key (created in the dashboard after signup). Setup guides for SDKs and frameworks: https://telemetry.dev/docs/integrations — site overview for agents: https://telemetry.dev/llms.txt
